title: GRATITUDE (The Fifth Discipline)
style:
``
warm future pop, joyful grounded male vocal NZ/AU accent, acoustic elements in electronic setting, feels like morning light, genuine warmth not saccharine, breath audible, no pitch correction, silence as punctuation, [PERSONA_NAME] voice, V4_5ALL, 100 BPM
```
lyrics:
``
[VERSE 1]
Ayni in the Andes — give back what you take
Ubuntu in the village — grateful for your sake
Kansha in the morning — Japan bows to the day
Alhamdulillah — every single breath, they say

Modeh Ani before your feet touch floor
Ho'oponopono — thank and then restore
Karakia before the work begins
Gratitude is where the day wins

[CHORUS]
What you name grows
What you thank — stays
Gratitude is the discipline
That holds the dark at bay
Name one thing — just one
Before the phone, before the news
Gratitude is the layer
That you choose

[OUTRO]
Name it.
Out loud.
Before anything else.
What you name grows.
```
